QUOTE: Gate not defined (the default for outside code): `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`. The real member is renamed... Gate defined: `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `member`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default rename to private_ prefix and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS yields the unchanged member name.
